label: GPT-6 Astra
output:
Right Mum, Kirsty and Auntie Linda,

I've got a wee surprise planned for Gran’s birthday and I’m absolutely buzzing to tell you! Morag’s said I can have Hair by Morag on Dumbarton Rd all to ourselves on Saturday 12 December from 1pm. She shuts at 12 on a Saturday, so we’ll have the place for a proper family pamper afternoon before we go out for dinner.

I want to do everybody’s hair for free as part of the birthday treat. That’s me, you three, Gran, Ava and Ruby — seven heads to get looking lovely! Cuts and blow-dries are no bother, and I’m happy to do colours too, but you’ll need to tell me what you fancy by **Friday 27 November** so I can get everything ordered from the wholesaler. Even if you’re just wanting a trim and a blow-dry, give me a shout so I can work out a wee running order.

Gran said at Easter she’d “love to go silver properly” but wouldn’t pay salon prices, so I’d love to chat to her about it on the day and see what we can do. Don’t anybody spoil the surprise! Mum, can you be in charge of getting her there for 1pm without telling her why? I’ll leave the cover story to you 😂

Kirsty, the wee ones can get braids and glitter spray. Ava and Ruby will be in their element. And Linda, this time we’re doing your colour somewhere without a cooker or a dog in the firing line!

Bring a bottle of fizz and we’ll make an afternoon of it. Morag’s happy for us to have a drink as long as we leave everything tidy, so we’re all on clean-up duty afterwards.

Dinner’s booked for **8.30pm that Saturday**, at the Italian place on Byres Rd. Table for nine, with Uncle Davie and Kirsty’s man joining us there, ready to celebrate Gran turning 80 on Sunday the 13th.

Cannae wait. Just get your hair requests back to me — and not a word to Gran!

Love yous xx
